articles.title: 1992년 당시 분석: 새 프리미어리그와 스카이 방송이 가져올 변화

events.title: 노팅엄 포리스트 sell defender Des Walker to 삼프도리아 for £1.5million.
Bass Brewery 's reported US$17.1 million proposal to sponsor the Premier League for the first three seasons fails after three – 아스널 , 리버풀 and 노팅엄 포리스트 – of the top-flight's 22 clubs object.
맨체스터 시티 sign winger Rick Holden from 올덤 애슬레틱 for £900,000.
맨체스터 유나이티드 sign 23-year-old 케임브리지 유나이티드 striker Dion Dublin for £1million.
에리크 캉토나 scores a hat-trick for 리즈 유나이티드 in a 4–3 victory over 리버풀 at Wembley Stadium in the 1992 FA Charity Shield .
첼시 pay a club record £2.1million for 노리치 시티 's Scottish striker Robert Fleck .
노리치 시티 sign Mark Robins from 맨체스터 유나이티드 for £800,000, while 에버턴 boost their attack with a £500,000 move for Paul Rideout . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 winger Stuart Slater joins 셀틱 for £1.5million.

The new FA Premier League begins. The first goal is scored by 셰필드 유나이티드 striker Brian Deane in the fifth minute of a 2–1 home win over 맨체스터 유나이티드. Alan Shearer begins his 블랙번 로버스 career with two goals against 크리스털 팰리스 in a 3–3 draw at Selhurst Park . 아스널 surrender a two-goal lead to lose 4–2 at home to 노리치 시티 , with Mark Robins scoring twice on his debut for the visitors. In Division One, 브리스틀 시티 and 포츠머스 draw 3–3 in a thrilling match at Ashton Gate . 피터버러 유나이티드 , in the second tier for the first time, achieve a surprise 1–0 home win over promotion favourites 더비 카운티 . In the new Division Three, debt ridden Maidstone United have their first game of the season cancelled and are given 48 hours to guarantee that they will be able to fulfill their fixtures for this season.

Sky Sports broadcast their first live Premier League game. 테디 셰링엄 scores the only goal as 노팅엄 포리스트 beat 리버풀 at the City Ground . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 begin their Division One promotion push with a 1–0 win at 반즐리 . 노츠 카운티 , who went down with 웨스트햄 유나이티드 last season, lose 1–0 at newly promoted 버밍엄 시티 .
Maidstone United resign from the Football League after being unable to guarantee that they can fulfil their fixtures for this season.

The second round of Premier League matches are played. 노리치 시티 and Coventry are the only two teams to begin the new league season with back-to-back victories, with 노리치 시티 defeating 첼시 2–1 at Carrow Road and Coventry winning 2–0 away to a 토트넘 홋스퍼 side who have yet to secure a successor to last season's top scorer 게리 리네커 in attack. 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer another disappointing result, losing 3–0 at home to 에버턴 . In Division One, 스윈던 타운 achieve a dramatic 4–3 away win over 브리스틀 로버스 .

Newly promoted 미들즈브러 win 4–1 home over defending champions 리즈 유나이티드 at Ayresome Park . A match at Boundary Park sees Oldham beat 노팅엄 포리스트 5–3. 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 첼시 draw 3–3 at Hillsborough , and 맨체스터 유나이티드 pick up their first point of the season in a 1–1 draw with 입스위치 타운 at Old Trafford . Landlords 웨스트햄 유나이티드 host tenants 찰턴 애슬레틱 at Upton Park , and Charlton win 1–0 to make it three consecutive league wins and top the table.
맨체스터 유나이티드 record their first Premier League win at the fourth time of asking when a late goal by Dion Dublin gives them a 1–0 win at 사우샘프턴.

체스터 시티 lose 2–1 to 스톡포트 카운티 in the first match at their new Deva Stadium home in the League Cup. 맨체스터 시티 equal the British national record for a defender (which they set last year when signing Keith Curle ) by paying £2.5 million for 윔블던 's Terry Phelan . In 리즈 유나이티드's 5–0 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼, 에리크 캉토나 becomes the first player to score a hat-trick in the Premier League. Newly promoted 입스위치 타운 take more points off a more favoured team, holding 리버풀 to a 2–2 draw at Portman Road . Charlton take their winning start in Division One to four matches with a 4–1 win over 브리스틀 로버스 at Upton Park.

QPR knock 코번트리 시티 off the top of the table with a 1–0 win at Highfield Road , to occupy top spot for the first time since October 1987. An East Midlands derby in Division One sees 레스터 시티 beat 더비 카운티 3–2 at Filbert Street .
토트넘 홋스퍼 pay £2.1 million for 노팅엄 포리스트's 26-year-old striker 테디 셰링엄 to fill the gap left in attack by 게리 리네커's departure in the close season.

블랙번 로버스 go top of the Premier League with a 2–0 away win over Coventry. QPR surrender their lead with a 1–0 defeat at 첼시. A thrilling match at Maine Road ends in a 3–3 draw between 맨체스터 시티 and 올덤 애슬레틱. 맨체스터 유나이티드's recovery continues with a 2–0 win at 노팅엄 포리스트. Division One leaders Charlton drop points for the first time this season with a goalless draw at home to Luton . 케임브리지 유나이티드, who qualified for the playoff last season, suffer a fourth successive defeat when they crash 4–1 to 스윈던 타운 at the County Ground .
엑서터 시티 manager Alan Ball and former 볼턴 원더러스 manager Phil Neal join the England national team coaching staff.
노리치 시티 go top of the Premier League with a 3–1 win over 노팅엄 포리스트 at Carrow Road .
